entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit support. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Oh, hi. I hope you can help. I'm just so confused by all of this. I ordered something a while ago and it's not right.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the item?
I... I guess it's a preference? I bought a jersey, but it's the wrong size. I tried it on once and it's just way too tight.
I understand. I can definitely help you with that. Do you have your order number handy?
Umm, let me see... yes, it's VF8675309. It's been a while, and I just don't understand the website's return process. Can't you just help me?
Of course. Let me pull that up for you. Okay, I see the order for the Pro-Series jersey, placed 74 days ago. You're looking to do an exchange for a different size, is that correct?
Yes, an exchange would be perfect. Is it too late? I feel so silly for waiting this long.

No reason to feel silly at all. Let me just confirm our policy... Okay, you're in luck. Our policy allows for returns and exchanges up to 90 days from the delivery date, so you're well within the timeframe.
Oh, thank goodness! That's such a relief. So I can send it back?

Absolutely. And since I see here that you're a VIP member with us, I'm going to process that exchange for you right now with complimentary expedited shipping on the new size. We'll also email you a prepaid label so you don't have to worry about the return shipping cost for the original jersey.
Wow, really? That's incredible. You've made this so easy for me. Thank you so much, Isaac!

It's my pleasure. I've just processed that for you. The new size should be with you in 1-2 business days, and the return label is on its way to your email inbox now. Just print it out and drop the package at any post office.
Perfect. Thank you again for all your help.
You're very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today at VeloFit?
No, that's everything. You've been great.
Happy to help. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
